sense.text:
There is nothing new on this earth: “The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.” The thing it speaks of is man.

Bishop Nathanyel has said for years that we are living this life over again, and it lines up with the scriptures. If you don’t know where you come from, you don’t know where you’re going, so we look at what happened to our forefathers to know what is going to happen in the future. The same way the prophets were persecuted, the same way our fathers were persecuted, the same way this truth has been through so much persecution, we will go through the same thing.

And Israel is not small anymore. Bishop thought they were big with forty brothers out there; now we can assemble thousands, and like Bishop says, that is still small, because the scripture says we are going to be an exceeding great army. Your job is to instruct many, not to learn this truth and sit at home going to movies and playing video games.

“Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.” The brothers being deported out of France: it happened in the book of Acts. Us being labeled a hate group over here in the States, being fired from our jobs, going through all these various things: these things have already happened. That is why, through comfort of the scriptures, we have hope.

John is told, “Go and take the little book”, and the angel says, “Take it, and eat it up; and it shall make thy belly bitter, but it shall be in thy mouth sweet as honey.” The little book is the scriptures, the understanding.

The sweet and the bitter is the severity of this truth. When you first learn the truth, it is sweet to know that you are Israel, chosen by God. Later you learn that you are going to be persecuted, that you are going to lose family members, jobs, things of that nature.

“And I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it up”: he got the understanding of the scriptures; he understood Deuteronomy 28. “And it was in my mouth sweet as honey”, because all the promises are for you, as Romans 9 says, all the prophecies of the kingdom of heaven: the dominion, the power and the kingdom.

“And as soon as I had eaten it, my belly was bitter.” If we are to be joint heirs with Christ, we have to go through what Christ went through. John the Baptist had his head chopped off and put on a platter, for correcting a man by the scriptures, and Christ never did anything wrong. You think you are going to sit beside them, be one of the 144,000, sitting in an Israelite camp, sharing no videos, going to no camp, nobody knowing you’re an Israelite, and never go through anything? You got to be kidding. That is the bitter part.

Everything that is good for us is bad for the rest of the world, and that is why we are the world’s most hated. “For we are unto God a sweet savour of Christ, in them that are saved, and in them that perish”.

“To the one we are the savour of death unto death”. When the nations hear the message and the prophecies, Psalms 149, Psalms 2, taking the heathen for our inheritance, Revelation 2:26, Revelation 13:10, we are the smell of death to them.

“And to the other the savour of life unto life”: to our people we are life. They say, that’s talking about me. There is redemption for our forefathers and foremothers, for our people that had crack cocaine brought into their neighborhoods, our brothers and sisters that were shot up with syphilis, that had their communities literally bombed, and flooded, with lakes built on top of them, that were given AIDS, whose music industry was hijacked.

That is how this truth is viewed by the world. When Captain Osee was fired, the letter denied it was about his private religious activities or freedom of speech; it said it was based solely on his teaching of a false faith, in direct conflict with their established doctrine and mission. Everything he taught was read out of the Bible, so that is what the world thinks of the Bible. These people do not believe the Bible, and the same organization has a big ass Christmas tree up right now and nobody has a problem with it.

It is nothing new under the sun. In the Inquisition their job was to search out and punish Judaizers, those who kept the commandments; if you did what the Bible said, they were mad as hell. The telltale signs they looked for: keeping the Sabbath by wearing a clean shirt, not lighting a fire or not working; eating meat during Lent, which is not in the Bible; not eating on the day of atonement; washing hands before praying; blessing a cup of wine; not eating pork; giving Old Testament names to children. All of these are going to come back in another form or fashion.

Back then you could hide a little. Today they can click a button and your face is everywhere. Those of you with jobs in the public, in positions of power and authority, have to operate the correct way, because everybody can’t be fired: some of us have to keep our jobs so we can support this truth from the background. Know which side of the table you are on.

It is already happening, in 2025: a Black Hebrew fighter pilot at Lockheed Martin says his boss tried repeatedly to convert him to Christianity. What they did in the 1400s they are doing now. They never want you to understand who you are. “For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head. They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.”

“They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.” That is the key part. They will never accept that you are the true Jew, an Israelite. Never. Freedom of religion is out the door the second you say you’re an Israelite: then you worship a false religion, you have a false faith.

That brother had a good name at his job. Captain Osee had a good name at his: on Monday the principals were asking him for tickets to the game; on Friday he was fired. All of a sudden things change, because they understand what it is you believe, and now they have a problem with you.

“But in all things approving ourselves as the ministers of God, in much patience, in afflictions, in necessities, in distresses”. As we go through these things, we are proving ourselves the ministers of God. Deacon Isaac just lost his wife, not two months ago, and a few weeks later he spent three weeks in Fiji, saying, I’m going to do the work, while some brothers and sisters aren’t done grieving yet. Bishop is very sick and never stopped the work one second. These men are proving that they are the ministers of God.

“As unknown, and yet well known”. Unknown, because those of you who are wise on the job don’t go around saying, I’m a Black Hebrew Israelite; and because the truth is still small. Two thousand people watching a class, out of eight billion people on the earth, is the dust of the balance. A lot of people still don’t know what is going on.

Yet well known: at the same time the Jews are doing skits on us, and every celebrity in the world is liking and commenting on our stuff. They try to play like they don’t know, but they know who we are.

precepts.why:
They call it heresy because it is not according to their standard: they have a Christmas tree up and celebrate all the man-made holidays. Paul confessed, “that after the way which they call heresy, so worship I the God of my fathers, believing all things which are written in the law and in the prophets”. We believe and exercise the things written in the law and the prophets.

“And herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence toward God, and toward men.” That is how brothers keep a good name on their jobs while the world calls the faith false. We are not trying to offend people; we are just trying to live a peaceable life by keeping the commandments of the Lord.

sense.text:
“And after this Joseph of Arimathea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews”. Joseph of Arimathea was a rich man, a disciple, a student of Christ, but secretly. He stayed low, and flexed occasionally. If the Jews, meaning the Pharisees and the scribes, had found out he was a follower of Christ, they would have tried to destroy his money, as we saw with Nick Cannon and DeSean Jackson.

He “besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave.” He had influence because of his wealth, and he used his influence to get the body of Christ and bury him. That is how our brothers and sisters in the entertainment field, in government, wherever, have to roll: secretly, supporting this truth.

We don’t need more foot soldiers as much as we need those with influence and financial backing to help in the background. And we all work jobs: how do you get fired if you don’t have a job? Persecution is coming on way higher levels than what we see today, and the Most High is going to call on you. You better answer the call.
“There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews”: a man of position.

“The same came to Jesus by night”. He came by night. A lot of you want to be on social media telling the world, putting a whole album out saying you’re the Israelite, and now where are you? Sit back, learn, and apply the commandments. Everybody has a position; that is why we have the bishops and deacons. Let them be on the forefront. And brothers who are scared to come to the school: you aren’t doing anything illegal. We read the Bible.

“Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.” Except the Lord was with the leadership, there is no way to go from a basement in Coney Island to over 180 countries visited and hundreds of congregations all over the world. People keep saying that group is just Acts 5. Apply that to the NFAC, around for a good two weeks, but not this organization. This is by God. They said it after Kyrie, they said it after Kanye, and we are still here. We aren’t going anywhere until they kill us.

They said we have a false faith, and some of you are going to get shook up by that. The white man doesn’t believe what we believe. That is why it is so important to know what you believe: the rest of the world will not accept it. Nobody wants to accept that you are above them.

“Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.” So when they say we have a false faith, that does nothing; it rolls off our back. It actually affirms that what we believe is true.

precepts.why:
If it were false, they wouldn’t worry about it. Santa Claus is false, and nobody does anything to Santa Claus: you let him come to your chimney and give him cookies and milk. But say you have to keep the commandments and that you’re an Israelite, and oh no, he has to go.

“It is the Son of God, whom they have confessed in the world. Then began I greatly to commend them that stood so stiffly for the name of the Lord.” You must know the scriptures, the commandments, to stand stiffly, because things are going to get tough in these last days. If you don’t believe, you are going to walk out the door. In 2018 it was easy, cut and dry, and still a lot of people left. What is going to happen when Esau runs an ABC special saying IUIC is a hate group? Are you going to run out the door?

sense.text:
They say what we believe is false. The tenets of IUIC: you must keep the faith of Christ; you must keep the commandments; we are the Israelites, and Jesus is black, God is black, and the Israelites are black. Let’s see if that’s false.

“And the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships”. Egypt means bondage, slavery: the Lord was going to bring us into slavery again, and we were brought into slavery on slave ships. That is historical fact, the transatlantic slave trade, the triangle slave trade where they traded people for goods and money. The whole world knows about it, and it is documented in the Bible. That doesn’t sound fake.

“Thou shalt see it no more again”: since we were taken into these various lands, we have not returned. “And there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen”: once we got to these lands, we were sold. “And no man shall buy you”: nobody is going to redeem you. This is so easy, and they say it is false.

precepts.why:
“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. That is what happened, and that is what is going on to this day.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” The pictures of the slave trade show it: yokes of iron upon our necks. These things are historical fact.

“And the Lord shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other”. Bishop showed last week that we were scattered all the way to the Solomon Islands, to the Oceania region. None of us knew that; then you open the books, and the white man knew. When Bishop started bringing out Africa, we said, that’s crazy, we’re in Africa. The understanding continues to rise.

“And there thou shalt serve other gods”: that is how we learned white Jesus. Some urban apologists say Christianity was in Africa, that it is an African religion. We had the Bible in Africa, that is true, but we never worshiped a white Jesus, never had a trinity, never had crosses. We kept the commandments, our names and our heritage.

We learned Christianity in slavery. The history books say it plainly: whites systematically undertook to convert bond servants to Christianity, believing it would bring civilization to the lowly savage slaves. Southern Baptists, Methodists and Presbyterians, slave owners, let bond servants worship in their churches, not as equals but as paternalists, as their daddy. And it was slave control: they hoped the slaves would believe a better life in the afterworld came only if they obeyed their earthly masters. It is the same today: you can read the Bible, but only with their interpretation; you can be a Jew, but a Talmudic Jew. All your religions came during slavery; John Smith created the Baptist religion in 1608.

After the alarm over Nat Turner’s insurrection, the slaveholders decided to give the slaves enough religious instruction to keep them from murdering their masters, because we were revolting. The Episcopal clergyman held a separate service on Sundays, and the Methodist and Baptist churches admitted them in the afternoon. That is why you go to church on Sunday afternoon. Where is white Jesus in the Bible? Where is Christmas, or Easter? None of it is in the Bible. Your slave master taught you this.

“And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the Lord shall lead thee.” We are an amazement today. A proverb and a byword are names other than your God-given name. That is how we lost our names: the Christian whipped Kunta Kinte until he said his name was Toby, and that is how we got the names we have today.

It is the same thing today. The second you confess anything other than white Jesus, you are fired from the job; Kyrie can’t go back out and play until he says his name is Toby; Kanye just had to apologize. There is no freedom of religion for Israelites. You can be anything else except a Jew.

A brother in Atlanta, just trying to do his job, was told to get off the property and that if he came back they would hang him; another brother was shot at trying to deliver packages. That shows the hatred they have against us.

sense.text:
Persecution is mandatory to get the kingdom. We can’t get mad and upset that the white man is persecuting us. Thus saith the Lord and thus saith Christ: if you want to sit in my seat, you have to drink of my cup.

“Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God.” We must go through tribulation. This is not a choice, not a multiple-choice question; it is mandatory. Everybody is not going to be killed, everybody is not going to be fired or hung, but there are going to be different levels of persecution, and he will not put anything on you that you can’t handle.
“And ye shall be hated of all men for my name’s sake: but he that endureth to the end shall be saved.”

“But when they persecute you in this city, flee ye into another”. Not if, but when. A brother in France was the first one picked up: they told him his class videos teach hatred and that he has to get out of France because he poses a threat to French security. He is being kicked out the same way it was in the Bible; we are living this life over again. He is the first, and he won’t be the last. That is why we have to gather ourselves together in these last days, and the brother is going to be taken care of.

“Ye shall not have gone over the cities of Israel, till the Son of man be come.” That shows that we would be scattered. The cities of Israel are the cities where the Israelites would reside: when we get persecuted we are not running to the land of Israel; it speaks of where our people would be. So when Paul went to Corinth, to Ephesus, to Galatia, he was going to the Israelites there.

Have you heard of any Christians being persecuted? Nobody says they can’t celebrate Christmas. If they teach the truth, why is nobody mad about it? “Even unto this present hour we both hunger, and thirst, and are naked, and are buffeted, and have no certain dwellingplace”.

“Being reviled, we bless; being persecuted, we suffer it: Being defamed, we intreat: we are made as the filth of the world, and are the offscouring of all things unto this day.” To this day we are the offscouring of all things.

“I write not these things to shame you, but as my beloved sons I warn you.” Paul warned us of these things that are going to come in these last days. There is no need to worry, no need to cry; in fact you should laugh. Esau says, you’re done. All right, cool, all praises, on to the next one, because we know what’s coming.

“O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me”. Persecution is coming. It is here, it has been here, and it is only going to increase; it isn’t going anywhere. If you’re scared, you’re in the wrong place. That is why we say we know what we worship.

precepts.why: “All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.” Persecution is coming against those that keep the commandments, and it comes wrongfully.

sense.text: “Blessed are they which are persecuted for righteousness’ sake: for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.” When you go through the persecution, understand that the kingdom of heaven is awaiting.
“Blessed are ye, when men shall revile you, and persecute you, and shall say all manner of evil against you falsely, for my sake.” Falsely.

“For great is your reward in heaven: for so persecuted they the prophets which were before you.” We are going to go through the same thing the prophets went through, like the brothers that got stoned in Kenya. There is so much persecution. These things happened before, and they are going to happen again.

Going to prison, being fired, being deported: these are not bad things. This is how you approve yourself as a minister of God.

Biblical examples of suffering wrongfully, starting with Joseph. “And the Lord was with Joseph”: keep that in mind. “And he was a prosperous man; and he was in the house of his master the Egyptian.” Joseph was loved of the Lord; he had a job, and he was prosperous.

Did he lose his job because he was late, or stealing, or did something wrong? “The Hebrew servant, which thou hast brought unto us, came in unto me to mock me: And it came to pass, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment with me, and fled out.” The dirty Egyptian said that he tried to rape her.

“His wrath was kindled. And Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison”. He didn’t do anything wrong. Almost all these cities that got bombed, all these big lynchings: nine times out of ten the white woman said she got raped. The same thing happens in the scriptures. And now with AI it is going to be the same thing: they are going to show imagery to make it look like things are happening that aren’t. Be ready for that.

“Now there arose up a new king over Egypt, which knew not Joseph.” He said, “Behold, the people of the children of Israel are more and mightier than we: Come on, let us deal wisely with them; lest they multiply”. In Egypt we weren’t doing anything wrong.

“If it be a son, then ye shall kill him: but if it be a daughter, then she shall live.” Any male child, kill him. Do you think that isn’t happening today? It isn’t by chance when a woman goes in and they say the baby probably isn’t going to make it, or make her do a C-section so she can’t have any more kids. These things are written in The Conspiracy to Kill Black Boys; it is the same thing.

And you wonder why today the black man is in prison and the most educated person on the planet is the black woman. That is by design. They want her educated, and they imprison the black man for doing nothing, so that we are at odds with each other. And then the black woman wants to divest and go back to the oppressor who is doing this.

“Then was Haman full of wrath.” Mordecai didn’t do anything; he said, I’m not bowing down to you, you’re not God. And “Haman sought to destroy all the Jews that were throughout the whole kingdom of Ahasuerus, even the people of Mordecai.”

Again the Israelites weren’t doing anything wrong. “There is a certain people scattered abroad and dispersed among the people in all the provinces of thy kingdom; and their laws are diverse from all people; neither keep they the king’s laws: therefore it is not for the king’s profit to suffer them. If it please the king, let it be written that they may be destroyed”.

Persecution has always been on our people. The nations have always come to their leaders to say, we have to get these people out of the way. This is nothing new.

See what happened to Jeremiah for teaching the word of God. They asked him what was going to happen, and he told them: “And the Chaldeans shall come again, and fight against this city, and take it, and burn it with fire.” Jerusalem was about to get burnt. Just like they ask us what is going to happen to America: it is going to be destroyed. And they didn’t like that.

“Wherefore the princes were wroth with Jeremiah, and smote him, and put him in prison”. All he did was tell them what the Lord told him. That is why when we prophesy we don’t care what anybody has to say: we say exactly what the Bible says, and we sugarcoat nothing. “And Jeremiah had remained there many days”.

Peter and the rest of the disciples were so powerful their shadow would heal people: “that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them.” “And they were healed every one”, by the word of God, and all the people loved what they saw. It is just like today when we go teach and prove all these pastors wrong, like when Bishop and them destroyed the pastors in Texas: the people loved it. They saw black men and Hispanic men joined together, sisters were calling in to the radio show crying, I’ve never seen anything like this. And the nations hate it.

“Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation”. Now we have the debate crew, the ADL, the black pastors having all-day conventions. Why weren’t they happy that people were being healed? Why are black Christians not happy that a group of black men is standing up in these last days doing what the Bible says? Our biggest enemy today is the black pastor. Ain’t that suspicious?

“And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison.” They weren’t doing anything wrong. Us being persecuted for doing nothing wrong is not new; it is all throughout the Bible. In white man Christianity the biggest persecution you have is the ham cooked too long on Thanksgiving, or your pastor trying to get the tithe out of you.

“What do we? for this man doeth many miracles. If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him”. That is why the plots have to come. They have to change the hearts and minds of the people from having a positive view of us; if not, they are going to look crazy throwing us in prison and killing us, which is going to have to happen anyway. They’ll look crazy regardless: when they kicked out the disciples, the truth grew bigger and bigger, and the same thing is going to happen today.

precepts.why:
“But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building; And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.”

Secret plots were had back then. Do you think there are secret plots today? You better believe it.

sense.text:
“And the dragon was wroth with the woman”: the woman is Israel. He went “to make war with the remnant of her seed, which keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus Christ.” You must have both, as Revelation 14:12 says. Anybody telling you not to keep the commandments isn’t at war with anything; nobody has a problem with him. The Christian church says you are cursed if you keep the commandments, so it does not fit the woman of Revelation 12. The world is only concerned with the twelve tribes of the nation of Israel.

That is COINTELPRO. We have legal documents showing that they spied on our leaders of the past: Malcolm X, Marcus Garvey, Fred Hampton, Martin Luther King, Stokely Carmichael. The FBI sent Martin Luther King a letter urging him to commit suicide. If black liberation wasn’t so powerful, why did they try to kill it? They never set up a government program to kill the LGBT movement, or the Italians; but whenever blacks and Hispanics try to pull themselves up by the bootstraps, it is an issue. Martin Luther King tried to hold hands with his oppressor, and they killed him. Fred Hampton tried to feed the kids and didn’t ask the white folks for anything, and they killed him. It doesn’t matter which way you go: they don’t want you to exist.

The first goal of COINTELPRO was to prevent the coalition of militant black nationalist groups: to prevent unity, mutual respect among us. That is why a lot of other camps carry so much hatred; it isn’t by chance. Some camps are fine, and send Bishop emails and texts saying they love what we’re doing, but there are other groups paid to create confusion in the Israelite movement. They want us fighting and bickering. When Christ walked the earth there were other groups, and he didn’t have a problem with that; neither do we.

“Endeavouring to keep the unity”. A coalition is unity, and that is why we must fight for this word: they don’t want us to have it. That is why they hate seeing us marching. Esau is the main one in the comments, mad as hell, because they hate seeing blacks and Hispanics unified.

The second goal was to prevent the rise of a Messiah who could unify and electrify the movement. They don’t want us to have leaders who can unify the masses. Anybody spiritual understands you have to have leaders; without leaders there is no order. Jethro told Moses to set up wise men to guide the people.

But you can’t prevent the rise of a black Messiah: Christ is coming back in his own time, and he is going to have 144,000 leaders with him. “And I heard the number of them which were sealed”: if you are sealed, you are a leader in this truth. “An hundred and forty and four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel”: not of the church, not from the Baptist or the Pentecostal, but from the twelve tribes of the nation of Israel. We are already here; they missed us.

This is why they struggle with the Gentiles of the New Testament: the Gentiles Paul went to in Corinth and Ephesus are how all twelve tribes are gathered back.

The third goal was to prevent violence on the part of black nationalist groups. We are not here for violence. They try to paint us as violent, yet we have had thousands of men out on any weekend in different cities all across America for years, and nobody has been harmed. In Philadelphia thousands of brothers were out there picking up trash.

“For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds”. We are not here for physical combat. We use the scriptures, and that is good enough.

The fourth goal was to discredit the groups and individuals, groups, not only individuals, to three segments: to the responsible negro community, the brothers and sisters with the degrees and good jobs who have influence and could help; to the white community and the liberals, and we don’t care what the white man thinks or need his money, because we have the Bible and made it work ourselves as in Acts 2 and Acts 4; and to the so-called radicals. They have it down to a T how to put us in a negative light.

That is why we must respect the leadership. Bishop had his YouTube banned back around 2010, before social media was even popping; they already knew there was a spirit in this man. “Let the elders that rule well be counted worthy of double honour, especially they who labour in the word and doctrine.” They get double honor because they have to deal with all these secret plots. A lot of us get to sit here and learn, and nothing happens to us for a while; these men built it from the ground up, from a basement to an international organization.

The final goal was to prevent the long-range growth of militant black organizations, especially among the youth. Twenty-three years of doing the work all over the world: we are defying all the goals the white man set up for us.

They know that we apply the scriptures. “Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men. If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.” We practice this, yet through propaganda they try to paint us as a violent organization. It isn’t going to work: the community cleanups and our involvement in the community paint the picture of who we really are.

They go after the youth. About two weeks ago Druski, one of the largest comedians in the black community and on social media, did a skit in purple and gold about Israel United in Christ, with over fourteen million views. That is not by chance: they want to discredit us among the youth, who are the ones watching these comedians. Esau sees us moving, so he has to make his chess move. It is like these people are gaining too many followers.

“If we let him thus alone, all men will believe on him”: if they left us alone, all men would believe. “And the Romans shall come and take away both our place and nation.” The white man is going to take away all your black leaders, because they are all set up; they are all appointed.

“And one of them, named Caiaphas, being the high priest that same year, said unto them”. The black pastor has something to lose with us gaining notoriety; he sees his position being taken from him. There is no separation between church and state: politicians pay the pastors to tell the congregants where to vote. A pastor goes to Israel, comes back, and starts handing out fifty-thousand-dollar checks, and the people look at him like he is the almighty.

And they bust up groups. A leader of the SPLC says they sow discord among the organizations and show the leaders as hypocrites, because the number one thing that drives people out is seeing their leadership corrupt. Who tries to sow discord in somebody else’s organization? That is the devil. So they work overnight trying to find anything on us, and they have nothing, because we keep the commandments.

Black identity extremist, white Christian nationalism, ethnic idolatry, racial idolatry, Hebrew Israelism, Black Hebrew Israelite, Canary Mission, the ADL, the SPLC: these terms were not on the main screen five years ago, and now they are the leading authority on who is good and who is bad. This is the new face of COINTELPRO. When the FBI director speaks of groups with an extraordinary commitment to their racial identity, he is talking about the Israelites, because every other organization says race doesn’t matter. Ask him about white identity extremists and he can’t give an answer. He says they investigate individuals, not groups, and he is lying: their own goals say groups and individuals. We never called ourselves Black Hebrew Israelites; that is the name the white man gave us. Even John 3:16: they were not running around with John 3:16 until the 1970s, right when the Israelites came on the scene. Exegesis and eisegesis were around, but nobody gave a damn until the Israelites destroyed it.

Why are they so infatuated with us if what we teach is false? If it isn’t true, nothing is going to happen, and they can go about their day. But they know what the truth is. They know if they leave us alone, Christ is going to crack the sky very soon, and their whole world is going to end. That is why they go so hard.

The liar knows what lie he told. Even if he made you think the answer is over here, he keeps a close eye on where the real answer is. They know we have the right answer, and that is why they watch us all day. That is why COINTELPRO exists, and why black identity extremist, racial idolatry, Hebrew Israelism and Black Hebrew Israelite exist: they know we have the truth.

“The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.” That is why they want our leaders, why they want to discredit our leaders, break up our groups, put hatred among our people, and mock us in front of everybody.

precepts.why:
“Good is set against evil, and life against death: so is the godly against the sinner, and the sinner against the godly.” We are at odds with our oppressor and our enemy. Everything we do, they show up and counter with something else.

Lately we have been dominating social media, a hundred to zero; nobody is fooling with the Israelites, and we have the streets on smash. So the oppressor changed his move. The leader of Israel, the man who just killed 70,000 people in the Gaza Strip, said the most important weapon is social media: not a gun, not a bomb, not the Iron Dome. So when people ask where our guns are: the weapon is the mind. When you can control the minds of the people, you have power. We are getting our people to understand who they are and to keep these commandments, and that is power. They bought TikTok, but it doesn’t change that they are still the devil.

sense.text: There are still brothers, and even sisters, who come to us thinking we have to fight a carnal fight; that is why Paul warned us. “Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.” The whole armour of God begins with learning this Bible.

“For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world”: the man of sin, to make it plain, “against spiritual wickedness in high places.” He sees the footprint and goes and buys it. How are you going to use a gun against somebody with a multitude of weapons at his disposal?

If none of this is true, and what we teach is heresy, they wouldn’t go to these great lengths and spend all this money. “And when Felix heard these things, having more perfect knowledge of that way”: like Katt Williams said, the liar knows the lie he told. Felix knew exactly what Paul was teaching.
“He sent for Paul, and heard him concerning the faith in Christ.” He knew about that way, and he wanted to hear it.

“And as he reasoned of righteousness, temperance, and judgment to come, Felix trembled”. Paul told him of righteousness, the commandments, of temperance, and of the judgment to come. If the judgment Paul taught were foolishness, like a black man coming out of the sky, Felix would have said, you’re just crazy. Instead he trembled. That is why Esau is crazy over us on the street corners: he hears Revelation 2:9 and it clicks, I have to get payback. As James said, the devils also believe, and tremble.

The Christian apologist Vocab Malone says the mockery shows our increased prominence and visibility, and that they need to take us seriously. He knows that if they leave us alone, everybody will believe on us. They said in Acts 5 to leave them alone and let them fall by themselves, but they won’t do that. Once they create the narrative they want, they are going to go through all those steps to create a negative image of who we are.

Once the persecution starts to come, what is going to happen? “This is an hard saying; who can hear it?” “But there are some of you that believe not.” Some of you don’t believe, and we are just waiting for the thing to happen where you bounce. “For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were that believed not, and who should betray him.”

“From that time many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.” The disciples left. When it got real, they bounced, and a lot of you will do the same. These scriptures are shown so you are ready, so you aren’t surprised when things happen.
They were at war. Maccabeus had to leave some of his men and go somewhere else where there was a hot fight.

“Now they that were with Simon, being led with covetousness, were persuaded for money”. A lot of you are going to leave for money. They “took seventy thousand drachms, and let some of them escape”: they let the enemies go, through money.

He accused those men “that they had sold their brethren for money, and set their enemies free to fight against them.” Many of you will sell out your brothers for money. The things written aforetime were written for our learning. Setting the enemy free is letting the white man have free reign in your mind, and it has already happened: a lot of brothers left and went back to the church.
“So he slew those that were found traitors”. They were found traitors; they became treacherous.
When persecution hits, certain people are going to turn: I ain’t ready for all this, I’m out. “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.”

This is how they are going to paint their narrative, and it has already happened: brothers have gone to do a documentary against us. “And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men”. There are going to be fake people among us, CIA agents sitting right here. Martin Luther King wanted to walk with white men, and they put a bullet through his head; we teach that a black Messiah is going to come and save the blacks, Hispanics and Native Americans. You think there are no agents in here, no fake believers? Absolutely there are. And we don’t care: this movement isn’t of man; it is of God.

“That they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.” Even though this persecution is coming, they cannot change what is written in the scriptures.

“This is the condition of the battle, which man that is born upon the earth shall fight; That, if he be overcome, he shall suffer as thou hast said”. This is the condition of the battle. We are at war; you must understand that.

“Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.” Slander is going to come, treachery is going to come, traitors are going to come; persecution, imprisonment, all these things are going to happen. We must endure hardness as good soldiers.

“No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.” For us to please the Most High God who has chosen us, we must endure these trials, tribulations and persecutions.

precepts.why: “But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.” Watch in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, and make full proof of our ministry.

sense.text: “Thou art my hope in the day of evil.” “Let them be confounded that persecute me, but let not me be confounded: let them be dismayed, but let not me be dismayed: bring upon them the day of evil, and destroy them with double destruction.” Double destruction on them that persecute us.

“When all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse”, and we call them to mind among the nations, and return unto the Lord and obey his voice, “then the Lord thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the Lord thy God hath scattered thee.”
“If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven”, all the way to Fiji, “from thence will the Lord thy God gather thee”. He is going to gather us.
“And the Lord thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.” He is going to put the curses on the enemies which persecuted us.

We are going to have redemption in these last days; all we have to do is endure the tribulation. “Like as now the neighbours of Sion have seen your captivity: so shall they see shortly your salvation from our God”. They have seen us in slavery; shortly they are going to see our salvation.

“My children, suffer patiently the wrath that is come upon you from God: for thine enemy hath persecuted thee”. He put us on slave ships and scattered us all over the world. He raped, robbed and murdered, and took our resources from all over the world. He took the lands of our brothers and sisters over here in America, the so-called Native Americans. He has done a lot of evil.

“But shortly thou shalt see his destruction, and shalt tread upon his neck.” We will tread upon the neck of our enemies.
